data.content: # Panthers bring win streak into game against the Senators. Published Oct. 20, 2026 4:10 a.m. ET. Florida Panthers (5-2-2, in the Atlantic Division) vs. Ottawa Senators (6-3, in the Atlantic Division). BOTTOM LINE: The Florida Panthers seek to extend a three-game win streak with a victory over the Ottawa Senators. Ottawa has a 6-3 record overall and a 2-1-0 record in Atlantic Division play. The Senators rank 10th in the league serving 10.3 penalty minutes per game. Florida is 5-2-2 overall and 0-1-0 against the Atlantic Division. The Panthers serve 12.8 penalty minutes per game to rank third in the league. The teams meet Wednesday for the first time this season. INJURIES: Senators: William Eklund: out (ankle), Thomas Chabot: out (undisclosed), Kurtis MacDermid: out (upper-body).
